cues.title: 接触决定表面变化
cues.caption: 只有接触氧的表面生成新的氧化层。
cues.captionEn: Only oxygen-exposed metal forms new oxide.
cues.zh: 新切面为什么从外面开始变暗？把同样的新切面作比较：一面接触干燥的含氧空气，一面隔绝氧。只有接触氧的表层改变，内部仍是金属。教材用氧化钠表示初期产物；切断氧的接触能停止这里的新变化，却不会把已经生成的层变回钠。真实空气还可能有水分和二氧化碳参与。
cues.en: Why does a fresh face darken from the outside? Compare two fresh surfaces: one meets dry, oxygen-containing air; the other is kept from oxygen. Only the exposed layer changes, while the core remains metal. The textbook represents the initial product as sodium oxide. Removing oxygen stops new change in this model; it does not restore the old layer to metal. Real air can also involve moisture and carbon dioxide.

cues.title: 同样的钠，不同的含氧量
cues.caption: 氧化物与过氧化物的氧，记账不同。
cues.captionEn: Oxide and peroxide oxygen have different oxidation states.
cues.zh: 受热的钠熔化、燃烧，教材给出的淡黄色产物是过氧化钠。与常温氧化物比较，钠都记作正一价，差别在氧。氧化物中的氧是负二价；过氧化物保留氧氧单元，两颗氧合计带两个负电荷，每颗记负一价。跟住相同的四个钠：形成氧化物需一个氧分子，形成过氧化物需两个。这个差别由原子与电子账本检验，不是从黄色火焰猜出来的。
cues.en: Heated sodium melts and burns, leaving the pale-yellow peroxide identified in the textbook. Compare it with the room-temperature oxide. Sodium is plus one in both; oxygen differs. Oxide oxygen is minus two. A peroxide oxygen pair has a total charge of minus two, so each oxygen is minus one. Follow the same four sodium atoms: forming oxide needs one oxygen molecule; forming peroxide needs two. Atom and electron accounting checks that difference. Yellow flame alone does not establish it.

cues.title: 把浮、熔、运动分开解释
cues.caption: 浮入多少由密度决定；金属体积随消耗缩小。
cues.captionEn: Density sets ideal immersion; consumption reduces metal volume.
cues.zh: 先停在水面。钠的密度略小于水，浮起时仍有大部分体积在水下。反应放热又能使它熔成小球；气体生成伴随运动。这些现象各有原因，不能都用活泼两个字代替。画面中浸入的比例按浮力计算，球的体积跟着剩余钠变化。运动与熔化阶段是定性重建，没有把它们画成测得的速度或温度。
cues.en: Pause at the waterline. Sodium is slightly less dense than water, so it floats with most of its volume submerged. Reaction heat can melt it into a droplet, while gas formation accompanies motion. These observations need separate explanations. Ideal immersion follows buoyancy, and metal volume follows the amount remaining. Motion and melting stages are qualitative reconstructions, not measured speed or temperature histories.

cues.title: 氢气里的氢从哪里来
cues.caption: 跟住水中的同一颗氢。
cues.captionEn: Follow the same hydrogen in water.
cues.zh: 气体里的氢从哪里来？钠没有氢，先跟住水中的这颗氢。两个钠各失去一个电子，水中两颗氢各得到一个电子份额，氧化数从正一变为零，组成氢气。剩下的氧和氢成为两个氢氧根，与钠离子留在水里。画的是净反应记账，不是逐步机理。酚酞变色支持碱性，但不能单凭颜色鉴定气体。水过量时，把钠的量加倍，理论氢气量也加倍。
cues.en: Where does the gas hydrogen come from? Sodium contains none, so follow this hydrogen in water. Two sodium atoms each lose one electron unit. Two water hydrogen atoms each gain one in the account, changing from plus one to zero and forming hydrogen gas. The remaining oxygen and hydrogen form two hydroxide ions beside sodium ions. This is net accounting, not an elementary mechanism. Indicator colour supports alkalinity, not gas identity. With excess water, doubling sodium doubles the theoretical hydrogen amount.

cues.title: 这次改变的是氧的价态
cues.caption: 钠仍为正一价，过氧化物的氧一升一降。
cues.captionEn: Sodium stays +1 while peroxide oxygen is oxidized and reduced.
cues.zh: 过氧化钠遇水，气体却能使带火星的木条复燃。这次钠已经是正一价，不能照搬金属钠的失电子解释。看两份过氧化物中的四颗氧：它们原来都记负一价。按净反应分配，两颗升到零，成为氧气；另两颗降到负二，进入氢氧根，失去和得到的电子份额正好相等。水补上其余氧和氢。这里追踪的是守恒的净账本，不是声称观察到了唯一的微观路径。
cues.en: With sodium peroxide, the gas relights a glowing splint. Sodium is already plus one, so the metal-sodium explanation cannot simply be reused. Look at four oxygen atoms in two peroxide units, all initially minus one. In the net account, two rise to zero and form oxygen gas; two fall to minus two and enter hydroxide. Electron loss balances gain. Water supplies the remaining oxygen and hydrogen. This tracks a conserved net account, not a uniquely observed microscopic pathway.

cues.title: 碱性相同，气体可以不同
cues.titleEn: Alkalinity does not fix the gas
cues.caption: 相同钠原子数，可以对应不同气体。
cues.captionEn: The same sodium count can give different gases.
cues.zh: 木条、升温和试纸，分别回答气体、热效应和酸碱性的问题。现在用教材同页的氧化钠做预测：如果也生成氢氧化物，一定要放气吗？氧化物中的氧接受水的一个质子，就能得到两个氢氧根，不需要氧化数变化。用相同四个钠作比较：金属钠给两个氢分子，氧化钠不放气，过氧化钠给一个氧分子，而三者都给四个氢氧根。
cues.en: The splint, warming and test paper answer different questions about gas, heat and alkalinity. Now predict from sodium oxide, discussed on the same textbook page. Must forming hydroxide release gas? Oxide oxygen can accept a proton from water to form two hydroxides without a change in oxidation state. Compare the same four sodium atoms: the metal gives two hydrogen molecules, the oxide no gas, and the peroxide one oxygen molecule. Each gives four hydroxide ions.

cues.title: 同族相似，产物不能只靠颜色
cues.titleEn: A shared group does not fix every product
cues.caption: 同样一个价电子，先支持一价离子的判断。
cues.captionEn: One valence electron supports singly charged ions.
cues.zh: 学习碱金属时，再把钠与钾放在一起。它们最外层都只有一个电子，失去后形成一价离子，这解释了性质中的共同部分。钾受热也熔化燃烧，火焰颜色却不同。颜色不能替我们数出产物里的氧，教材还提醒钾可能形成多种氧化物。因此这里保留氧化产物的判断，不凭火焰指定唯一化学式。
cues.en: Compare sodium and potassium as alkali metals. Each has one outer electron and forms a singly charged ion on losing it, explaining part of their shared behaviour. Heated potassium also melts and burns, but its flame colour differs. Colour does not count oxygen in the product, and the textbook notes that potassium can form multiple oxides. We therefore retain oxidation products without assigning one formula from the flame alone.

cues.title: 更剧烈不等于更多氢气
cues.titleEn: More vigorous does not mean more hydrogen
cues.caption: 更剧烈，意味着更多氢气吗？
cues.captionEn: Does more vigour mean more hydrogen?
cues.zh: 钾与水的演示比钠更强烈，但这是否意味着最后氢气更多？先看结构：由锂到钠再到钾，电子层增多，第一电离能降低，支持最外层电子更容易移走的趋势。电离能描述的是孤立气态原子，不能单独当作水中反应速率。对锂较缓和的判断仍是教材中的预测。最后按电子账本核对：相同物质的量的钠和钾，都是两个金属对应一个氢分子，剧烈程度不同并不改变这个配比。
cues.en: Potassium reacts more vigorously with water than sodium. Does that mean more hydrogen at the end? From lithium to sodium to potassium, occupied shells increase and first ionization energy falls, supporting easier outer-electron removal. That energy concerns isolated gas-phase atoms; it is not an aqueous reaction-rate scale. A gentler lithium response remains the textbook prediction. Finally check the electron account: equal mole amounts of sodium and potassium both give one hydrogen molecule per two metal atoms. Different vigour does not change this ratio.

question.zh: 切面为什么只从外面变暗？
question.en: Why does a fresh surface darken from the outside?

principle.zh: 接触空气中的氧使表面钠氧化，未接触的金属内核仍可保留；灰暗外观本身不能唯一鉴定化合物。
principle.en: Contact with oxygen changes exposed sodium while an unexposed metal core remains. A dull appearance alone does not identify a unique compound.

transferQuestion.zh: 新切面隔绝氧气后，还会在此模型中继续生成氧化层吗？
transferQuestion.en: Would a freshly cut surface keep growing oxide in this model without oxygen contact?

answer.zh: 不会继续生成；已形成的氧化层也不会自动恢复成钠。这里控制的是干燥氧接触，真实潮湿空气还有别的反应。
answer.en: No new oxide forms without oxygen contact, and existing oxide does not revert to sodium. This comparison isolates dry oxygen contact; humid air has additional chemistry.

question.zh: 同样是钠，为什么含氧量不同？
question.en: Why can sodium form products with different oxygen contents?

principle.zh: 教材的两种条件得到氧化物和过氧化物；钠均为正一价，氧化物含氧负二价，过氧化物含总电荷为负二的氧氧单元，氧平均负一价。
principle.en: The textbook conditions give oxide or peroxide. Sodium is +1 in both; oxide has oxygen at −II, while a peroxide O–O unit has total charge −2 and each oxygen at −I.

transferQuestion.zh: 同样消耗 4 mol Na，分别形成纯 Na₂O 与纯 Na₂O₂，需要多少 O₂？
transferQuestion.en: If 4 mol Na forms pure Na₂O or pure Na₂O₂, how much O₂ is required?

answer.zh: 分别需要 1 mol 与 2 mol O₂。这个原子和电子账本不凭温度单独预测真实空气中的相组成。
answer.en: The requirements are 1 mol and 2 mol O₂. This atom and electron account does not predict real-air phase composition from temperature alone.

question.zh: 水面上的小球为何放出氢气？
question.en: Why does the droplet on water release hydrogen?

principle.zh: 密度、熔化与气体生成解释不同现象；净反应中钠失电子，水中的一部分氢由正一变为零，余下的氧氢进入氢氧根。
principle.en: Density, melting and gas formation explain different observations. In the net redox account sodium loses electrons; some water hydrogen changes from +I to zero, while oxygen and the remaining hydrogen form hydroxide.

transferQuestion.zh: 水过量时，2 mmol Na 与 4 mmol Na 的理论氢气量分别是多少？
transferQuestion.en: With excess water, what hydrogen amounts follow from 2 mmol and 4 mmol Na?

answer.zh: 分别为 1 mmol 与 2 mmol H₂。这是产物计量，不是把金属量翻倍就宣称反应速率翻倍。
answer.en: The amounts are 1 mmol and 2 mmol H₂. This predicts product yield, not a doubling of reaction rate.

question.zh: 同样显碱性，为什么气体不同？
question.en: Why can alkaline products come with different gases?

principle.zh: 过氧化物中的钠已经为正一价；净反应中的氧负一价同时向零与负二价分配。氧化钠只与水生成氢氧化物，不需要放出气体来完成计量。
principle.en: Sodium in peroxide is already +1. In the net account peroxide oxygen at −I splits between zero and −II. Sodium oxide can form hydroxide with water without producing gas.

transferQuestion.zh: 各含 4 mmol 钠原子的金属钠、氧化钠、过氧化钠遇过量水，气体与氢氧根各是多少？
transferQuestion.en: For metal, oxide and peroxide each containing 4 mmol sodium atoms, what gas and hydroxide amounts follow with excess water?

answer.zh: 金属钠给 2 mmol H₂，氧化钠无气体，过氧化钠给 1 mmol O₂；三者均给 4 mmol OH⁻。氧化钠是教材同页理论迁移，不冒充另做的实验。
answer.en: The gases are 2 mmol H₂, none, and 1 mmol O₂ respectively; each gives 4 mmol OH⁻. The oxide comparison applies the theory on the same textbook page and is not presented as an additional performed experiment.

question.zh: 反应更剧烈，会得到更多氢气吗？
question.en: Does a more vigorous reaction make more hydrogen?

principle.zh: 钠和钾的价电子数相同，形成一价离子后对应相同的氢气计量；原子结构与气态电离能支持失电子趋势，但不能单独计算水中反应速率。
principle.en: Sodium and potassium each have one valence electron and form singly charged ions, giving the same hydrogen ratio. Atomic structure and gas-phase ionization energy support the electron-removal trend but do not alone determine aqueous reaction rates.

transferQuestion.zh: 相同物质的量的钠与钾充分遇水，钾反应更强烈就一定有更多氢气吗？
transferQuestion.en: For equal amounts in moles of sodium and potassium, does the more vigorous potassium reaction give more hydrogen?

answer.zh: 不会；均为每 2 mol 金属对应 1 mol H₂。对锂更缓和的判断是教材要求提出的预测，不是此处做过的统一速率实验。
answer.en: No. Each gives 1 mol H₂ per 2 mol metal. The gentler lithium response remains the textbook prediction, not a measured three-metal rate experiment here.

topicSuggestion.name: 钠、氧化物与过氧化物
topicSuggestion.title: 同样含钠，为什么反应产物不同？
topicSuggestion.titleEn: Why do substances containing sodium give different products?
topicSuggestion.description: 从表面接触对照追到氧的价态与水中氢的去向，用原子和电子账本预测不同气体，再比较钠和钾的等量产氢。
topicSuggestion.descriptionEn: Follow oxygen contact, oxygen states and water hydrogen, then use conserved atoms and electrons to predict gases and compare equal amounts of sodium and potassium.
